+
+Revision ID: 0014_project_tracking
+Revises: 0009_id_sequences
+Create Date: 2026-06-22
+
+Additive changes to `projects` table:
+- business_id (UNIQUE) — auto-generated SWA-2025-PRJ-NNN via id_gen
+- milestone — "Concept", "DBR", "Calculation", "Drawing", "Validation", "Closeout"
+- progress_indicators (JSONB) — e.g. {"design_pct": 30, "calc_pct": 10, "drawing_pct": 0}
+- status_updates (TEXT)
+- team_leader_id (UUID FK→users.id)
+- project_owner_id (UUID FK→users.id)
+- notes (TEXT)
+
+Backfills business_id for any existing rows by allocating a contiguous
+block from the id_sequence counter and updating id_sequence.last_value
+so future calls do not collide.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sqlalchemy as sa
+from alembic import op
+from sqlalchemy.dialects import postgresql
+
+
+revision = "0014_project_tracking"
+down_revision = "0009_id_sequences"
+branch_labels = None
+depends_on = None
+
+
+def upgrade() -> None:
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("business_id", sa.String(length=64), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("milestone", sa.String(length=50), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("progress_indicators", postgresql.JSONB(), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("status_updates", sa.Text(), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("team_leader_id", postgresql.UUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("project_owner_id", postgresql.UUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("notes", sa.Text(), nullable=True),
+    )
+
+    op.create_foreign_key(
+        "fk_projects_team_leader_id_users",
+        "projects",
+        "users",
+        ["team_leader_id"],
+        ["id"],
+        ondelete="SET NULL",
+    )
+    op.create_foreign_key(
+        "fk_projects_project_owner_id_users",
+        "projects",
+        "users",
+        ["project_owner_id"],
+        ["id"],
+        ondelete="SET NULL",
+    )
+
+    op.execute(
+        """
+        DO $$
+        DECLARE
+            yr INT := EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW())::INT;
+            counter INT := 0;
+            seq_exists BOOLEAN;
+            rec RECORD;
+        BEGIN
+            SELECT EXISTS (
+                SELECT 1 FROM id_sequence WHERE type_code = 'PRJ' AND year = yr
+            ) INTO seq_exists;
+
+            IF seq_exists THEN
+                SELECT last_value INTO counter FROM id_sequence
+                WHERE type_code = 'PRJ' AND year = yr;
+            END IF;
+
+            FOR rec IN SELECT id FROM projects WHERE business_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at LOOP
+                counter := counter + 1;
+                UPDATE projects
+                SET business_id = 'SWA-' || yr || '-PRJ-' || LPAD(counter::TEXT, 3, '0')
+                WHERE id = rec.id;
+            END LOOP;
+
+            IF seq_exists THEN
+                UPDATE id_sequence
+                SET last_value = counter
+                WHERE type_code = 'PRJ' AND year = yr;
+            ELSIF counter > 0 THEN
+                INSERT INTO id_sequence (type_code, year, last_value)
+                VALUES ('PRJ', yr, counter);
+            END IF;
+        END $$;
+        """
+    )

+    op.create_index(

+    op.create_index(

+    )
+    op.create_index(

+        unique=False,
+    )

+

"""Business-ID generator.

Produces IDs like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`. Uses a DB-backed sequence counter
(`IdSequence`) so each (type_code, year) pair advances atomically.

Pass `year=0` for "continuous across years" (per meeting: DBR/CAS/GAD numbers
do not reset per year).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.id_sequence import IdSequence


def current_year() -> int:
    return datetime.utcnow().year


def next_business_id(db: Session, type_code: str, year: int | None = None) -> str:
    """Generate the next business ID for `type_code`.

    Args:
        db: SQLAlchemy session.
        type_code: Short code like `CLT`, `INQ`, `SA`, `TKN`, `PRJ`, `EMP`,
            `FDB`, `TRN`, `HW`, `PROC`, `COL`, `INN`, `FB`, `CMP`,
            `IG`, `LI`, `WEB`, `CON`, `DBR`, `CAS`, `GAD`, `KDR`, `RDP`,
            `VAL`, `RPT`, `OTH`.
        year: Calendar year (defaults to current year). Pass `0` for
            continuous counters (e.g. DBR numbers per the meeting transcript).

    Returns:
        A formatted ID string like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`.
    """
    if year is None:
        year = current_year()

    seq = (
        db.query(IdSequence)
        .filter_by(type_code=type_code, year=year)
        .with_for_update()
        .one_or_none()
    )
    if seq is None:
        seq = IdSequence(type_code=type_code, year=year, last_value=0)
        db.add(seq)
        db.flush()

    seq.last_value += 1
    db.flush()

    return f"SWA-{year}-{type_code}-{seq.last_value:03d}"

MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}

CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
    ".dwg": "application/acad",
    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
    ".png": "image/png",
    ".zip": "application/zip",
}


def _ensure_dir(project_id: uuid.UUID, category: str) -> Path:
    d = UPLOAD_DIR / str(project_id) / "documents" / category
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def _save_file(project_id: uuid.UUID, category: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
    d = _ensure_dir(project_id, category)
    path = d / safe_name
    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
    return str(path), mime


def _get_latest_version(db: Session, project_id: uuid.UUID, original_name: str) -> Document | None:
    return (
        db.query(Document)
        .filter(
            Document.project_id == project_id,
            Document.original_name == original_name,
            Document.is_deleted == False,
        )
        .order_by(Document.version.desc())
        .first()
    )


def upload_document(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    file_bytes: bytes,
    original_name: str,
    category: str,
    uploaded_by: uuid.UUID | None,
) -> Document:
    if len(file_bytes) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
        raise ValueError("File exceeds 50MB limit")

    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid file type. Allowed: {', '.join(sorted(ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS))}")

    latest = _get_latest_version(db, project_id, original_name)
    version = (latest.version + 1) if latest else 1
    previous_version_id = latest.id if latest else None

    file_path, mime_type = _save_file(project_id, category, original_name, file_bytes)

    doc = Document(
        project_id=project_id,
        name=original_name,
        original_name=original_name,
        file_path=file_path,
        category=category,
        version=version,
        previous_version_id=previous_version_id,
        size_bytes=len(file_bytes),
        mime_type=mime_type,
        uploaded_by=uploaded_by,
    )
    db.add(doc)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(doc)
    return doc


def list_documents(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    category: str | None = None,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
) -> tuple[list[Document], int]:
    query = db.query(Document).filter(Document.project_id == project_id, Document.is_deleted == False)
    if category:
        query = query.filter(Document.category == category)
    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(Document.uploaded_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
    return items, total


def get_document(db: Session, document_id: uuid.UUID) -> Document | None:
    return db.query(Document).filter(Document.id == document_id, Document.is_deleted == False).first()


def soft_delete_document(db: Session, document_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    doc = get_document(db, document_id)
    if not doc:
        return False
    doc.is_deleted = True
    db.commit()
    return True


def get_document_versions(db: Session, document_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[Document]:
    doc = get_document(db, document_id)
    if not doc:
        return []

    all_versions: list[Document] = []
    current: Document | None = doc
    while current:
        all_versions.append(current)
        if current.previous_version_id:
            current = db.query(Document).filter(Document.id == current.previous_version_id).first()
        else:
            current = None

    return all_versions

import uuid

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.boq_parser import parse_excel, parse_json
from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.db.repositories.boq_repo import create_boq, get_next_version_number

UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/boqs")
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024  # 10MB
ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".xlsx", ".json"}


def _ensure_dir(project_id: uuid.UUID) -> Path:
    d = UPLOAD_DIR / str(project_id)
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def _save_file(project_id: uuid.UUID, file_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> str:
    d = _ensure_dir(project_id)
    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{file_name}"
    path = d / safe_name
    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
    return str(path)


def upload_boq(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    file_bytes: bytes,
    file_name: str,
    content_type: str | None,
    parsed_by: uuid.UUID | None,
    notes: str | None = None,
) -> dict:
    if len(file_bytes) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
        raise ValueError("File exceeds 10MB limit")

    ext = Path(file_name).suffix.lower()
    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid file type. Allowed: {ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS}")

    if ext == ".xlsx":
        items = parse_excel(file_bytes)
    else:
        items = parse_json(file_bytes)

    if not items:
        raise ValueError("No valid line items found in file")

    file_path = _save_file(project_id, file_name, file_bytes)
    version_number = get_next_version_number(db, project_id)

    boq = create_boq(
        db=db,
        project_id=project_id,
        version_number=version_number,
        file_name=file_name,
        file_path=file_path,
        parsed_by=parsed_by,
        items=items,
        notes=notes,
    )

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="boq.upload",
        entity_type="boq",
        entity_id=boq.id,
        user_id=parsed_by,
        after_json={
            "project_id": str(project_id),
            "version_number": version_number,
            "file_name": file_name,
            "items_count": len(items),
        },
    )

    return {
        "id": boq.id,
        "project_id": boq.project_id,
        "version_number": boq.version_number,
        "file_name": boq.file_name,
        "file_path": boq.file_path,
        "parsed_by": boq.parsed_by,
        "parsed_at": boq.parsed_at,
        "notes": boq.notes,
        "is_active": boq.is_active,
        "created_at": boq.created_at,
        "item_count": len(items),
    }

from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException

security_scheme = HTTPBearer()


def get_current_user(
    creds: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security_scheme),  # noqa: B008
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
) -> User:
    try:
        payload = decode_token(creds.credentials)
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid or expired token") from e
    if payload.get("type") != "access":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Wrong token type")
    user = get_by_id(db, UUID(payload["sub"]))
    if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="User not active")
    return user


def require_role(required: Role) -> Callable[[User], User]:
    def _checker(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> User:  # noqa: B008
        if not role_includes(Role(user.role), required):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Insufficient role")
        return user

    return _checker

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import datetime

async def test_business_id_auto_generated(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="BIZ-001")
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={
            "client_id": client_id,
            "name": "BizProj",
            "code": "BP-001",
            "status": "Lead",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    body = r.json()
    year = datetime.utcnow().year
    assert body["business_id"] == f"SWA-{year}-PRJ-001"

async def test_business_id_increments(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="INC-001")

    ids = []
    for i in range(3):
        r = await authed_admin_client.post(
            "/api/projects",
            json={
                "client_id": client_id,
                "name": f"IncProj{i}",
                "code": f"IN-{i:03d}",
                "status": "Lead",
            },
